title: pulse
description: Generates a pulse sequence matrix for a given digital brain image.

input_file.description: 4D digital brain, resolution can be any.
input_file.title: Input digital brain file

seq.description: Type of pulse sequence; default=epi (epi OR ge)
seq.title: Pulse sequence

te.description: The time from the first RF to the first echo; default=0.03s
te.title: Echo time

tr.description: The time between the two RF pulses applied on the same part of the object; default=3s
tr.title: Repetition time

trslc.description: The time that takes for the acquisition of one slice; default=0.12s
trslc.title: Slice acquisition time

nx.description: Resolution in x of the output image; default=64
nx.title: X resolution

ny.description: Resolution in y of the output image; default=64
ny.title: Y resolution

riset.description: Time it takes for the gradient to reach its max value; default=0.00022s
riset.title: Gradient rise time

gap.description: Gap between the slices in meters; default=0m
gap.title: Slice gap

zstart.description: The lowest position in the slice direction in meters; default=0m
zstart.title: Slice start position

slcdir.description: Slice acquisition direction/orientation; default=z- (x+,x-, y+,y- or z+,or z-)
slcdir.title: Slice acquisition direction

phasedir.description: Phase encode direction/orientation; default=y+ (x+,x-, y+,y- or z+,or z-)
phasedir.title: Phase encode direction

readdir.description: Read-out direction/orientation; default=x+ (x+,x-, y+,y- or z+,or z-)
readdir.title: Read-out direction

cover.description: Phase partial Fourier coverage in percentage; default=100 (min=50, max=100)
cover.title: Fourier coverage
